picks.title: Come Follow Me Aug. 31-Sept. 6, 2026-Psalms 87-150
picks.summary: This is our last week in Psalms. And it’s gonna be a good one!  In the CFM manual for this week, it teaches us that the traditional Jewish name for the book of Psalms is Tehillim, a Hebrew word that means praises.  It’s related to the exclamation Hallelujah! And then the manual states, if you had to pick one word to sum up Psalms, praise would be a good choice!  And praise would be a really good choice!  But if I had to pick one word to sum up the Psalms for me it would be “lovingkindness”.  Which translated into Hebrew would be Hesed!  And I am sure that does not come as a surprise to you!
picks.reason: Reflects on Psalms with emphasis on praise and lovingkindness.
